description: This Java source file defines an abstract Hibernate interceptor for managing immutability constraints on certain entities within the OpenMRS framework. It provides mechanisms to prevent modifications to immutable entities while allowing certain properties to be mutable via subclassing and thread-local configurations.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityInterceptor
classes.description: An abstract Hibernate interceptor designed to enforce immutability rules on specific entity types within the OpenMRS framework. It prevents changes to immutable entities, allows certain properties to be mutable via subclassing, and supports thread-local mutability adjustments.

methods.name: getSupportedType
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to specify which entity class the interceptor applies to.

methods.name: getMutablePropertyNames
methods.description: Returns an array of property names that are considered mutable; subclasses can override to specify mutable properties. Returns null or empty for fully immutable entities.

methods.name: ignoreVoidedOrRetiredObjects
methods.description: Determines whether voided or retired objects are considered mutable. Defaults to false.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Overridden method that intercepts entity updates. It checks for unauthorized modifications to immutable entities' properties and throws an exception if such modifications are detected, respecting the mutability rules.

methods.name: isMutableProperty
methods.description: Helper method to check if a property is allowed to be mutable, considering subclass-defined mutable properties and thread-local mutable properties.

methods.name: addMutablePropertiesForThread
methods.description: Allows temporary addition of mutable properties for the current thread, enabling controlled modification during specific operations.

methods.name: removeMutablePropertiesForThread
methods.description: Removes any thread-local mutable property configurations, typically called in a finally block to restore state.
